output.subject: We have received your complaint about monthly charges on your account
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know that a person has read it carefully.

You told us you opened your account in 2021 as a free checking account, and that this was the reason you chose it. You mentioned that $12 has been taken from your account every month for the past seven months, a total of $84. You also said you did not know about any fee and that nobody sent you anything about one. You have asked for the $84 to be given back, and you asked us to call you.

You also told us you have bills to pay and children to look after, and that you cannot afford this. We're sorry for the worry and stress this has caused you.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. We have noted your request for a phone call.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check the account's original terms and whether and when a $12 monthly fee was introduced.
Confirm whether a fee-change notice was sent to the customer, and how and when.
Verify the number of $12 charges and the $84 total.
Decide on the customer's request to refund $84; the draft makes no commitment.
Decide whether to call the customer, and confirm a contact number is on file; the draft only says the request was noted.
Customer says they cannot afford the charges and has bills and children; consider whether hardship support or account options should be discussed.
Mode is ACKNOWLEDGE ONLY: the draft does not name the reviewing team and takes no position on the substance.
